author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
A Frenzy map by _DISTRACTION_, xXBatManXx, and Junr.

It's a map. I'll make a CTF out of this, and maybe even a TDM.

We need Frenzy maps, so I fast-tracked this one. Batman built the smaller boats, Junr built the large boat, I built the rest.

Photos: http://imgur.com/a/yO4kH
Download (XML Included): https://www.dropbox.com/s/0rdcbxoj3od3uj5/Tropics%20Frenzy.zip?dl=0

replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
Good job with this! But I think there should be some changes : 

-It might be just me but the team on this ships side looks longer than the other side.
-Make it wider by a few blocks because the amount of space you're getting on the 2 river banks is quite small & players can get stuck in the vines when fighting.
-As Bloodoh stated, there could be some shape to it.

Anyways, Good luck!
